in_sanskrit.name: Jitin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jitin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। From the Sanskrit root 'jita' meaning 'victorious'. This name is given to a boy who is believed to bring victory and success in life.

in_tamil.name: Jitin
in_tamil.long_meaning: Jitin ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। From the Sanskrit root 'jita' meaning 'victorious'. This name is given to a boy who is believed to bring victory and success in life.

in_telugu.name: Jitin
in_telugu.long_meaning: Jitin ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। From the Sanskrit root 'jita' meaning 'victorious'. This name is given to a boy who is believed to bring victory and success in life.

in_marathi.name: Jitin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jitin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit root 'jita' meaning 'victorious'. This name is given to a boy who is believed to bring victory and success in life.

in_bengali.name: Jitin
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jitin একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। From the Sanskrit root 'jita' meaning 'victorious'. This name is given to a boy who is believed to bring victory and success in life.
